narr: A strong upper low forced a round of severe thunderstorms across the region. Flooding, high wind gusts, hail, and tornadoes occurred in Southeast Texas as a result of this system.
ev: Deputy reports around Trout Creek indicated 4 to 5 inches of water over area roads.
Numerous roads were closed due to high water across Tyler County including FM 1012, 1745, 92, 1943, and 2827 and Highways 69 and 190.
Highways 87 and 190 and FM 1414 closed in Newton due to high water.
Numerous roads were closed across Jasper County including portions of Highway 96 and FM 1747, 1004, and 777. Water was greater than 2 feet deep on Highway 96.
Little Pine Island Bayou near Thicket overtopped its banks flooding nearby roadways.

Over one foot of rain occurred around the Kirbyville area in a short period of time. Several feet of flood water inundated numerous homes. The local fire department conducted several high water rescues.
lsr: Site PIKT2 reports Pin Oak at S. Elizabeth Ave in Kirbyville out of its banks.
Little Pine Island Bayou (JYLT2) came out of its banks reaching minor flood.
Deputy reports several areas of water 4 to 5 inches over roadways from Trout Creek to Old Salem.
Reports of several feet of water in homes in Kirbyville.
Video of volunteer fire department performing water rescues near Pin Oak Creek in Kirbyville.
